snippet.title: Broken Memories
snippet.description:
#Remember0416 🎗️

“Broken Memories - Sewol”

The Day I was cold  in deep sea
Out of  the breath in dark sea
Alone, I’m alone in the fearful sea
Can’t nothing to do in this sea

Hope, someone save me from the ship
Faith, someone rescue me from the ship
But there’s no one in this ship
Sorrow, endless sorrow in this sea

Who left me alone in this place
Who left me alone in the death
Who left me alone in the pulse
Who left me alone in the mess

Want, see my mommy only once
Want, see my daddy only once
Want, say I love you only once
Maybe gonna miss you forever

Hate, this dark I hate
Cry,  this cold I cry
Deny, this time I deny
Give up, this time I give up

Do they remember me forever?
Who remember me  forever?
Can I remember them forever?
Bye, it’s time to say goodbye

Pain, gone from me fade away
Sleep, gonna sleep fade away
Friends, they call me far away
Run, I'm gonna run now to my friends

Don't worry about me and us
We have a good time in the sky
Now we make our dreams come true
Rest, our soul gonna rest

Want to find truth of the day
who is guilty of the day
Can I know truth of the day
Please, tell me truth of the day

Fly, I wanna fly high
Beyond over sky I fly
Into the world I live
Dream the place I dreamed
